description.text: Partnering with exceptional entrepreneurs from SF to NY, London to Tel Aviv, from Seed to IPO.

targetApplicants.text: When it comes to the founders we work with , we look for the unexpected. The groundbreakers and game-changers with a fire inside that can’t be dimmed or duplicated. Because at Index, we’re invested in the people behind great ideas.
